sources.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models
sources.snippet: Liquid AI has released LFM3, its new generation of Liquid Foundation Models. Liquid AI LFM3 is a family of 6 open-weight, 2B-class models built on one shared backbone. The family covers text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks. Every model can be fine-tuned on a single GPU.
